request_text: Fix #663: once contract-packs-v<version> is merged into HEAD, check refuses any change to a packs contract file (file-kinds.yaml, schemas/, conformance/) under the released heading until the -SNAPSHOT is reopened, as for the charter contract. ReleaseGate.java and CheckReleaseGate.java, reusing the existing tag-merged probe; red-first ReleaseGateTest cases; packs README and change fragment; separate draft PR.
